text:
priya: heads-up bringing cormorant-13b (hf/cormorant-13b-v1) into the eval harness. initial runs show weird tokenization around non-breaking spaces and “zero-width joiner” sequences, causing chat templates to insert extra sentinels. CI job keeps failing on the quantized (q4f) runner with a 504 after ~30s.

sam: can you paste the tokenizer error? or a minimal example?

priya: here's a snippet from the eval-runner logs: 
```
ERROR EvalRunner: TokenizerError: unexpected token � at pos 128
  model: hf/cormorant-13b-v1
  template: chat-default-v2
  request_id: 8f3a2b
```

matt: 504 from the quant runner usually means the async KV cache loop blocked on a different shape. we saw a similar symptom on orion13b where prefix caching and batched KV reshape mismatch caused the coroutine to hang. can you share the runner config (batch, max_seq, pad)?

priya: runner config we used: 
```yaml
batch_size: 8
max_tokens: 1024
pad_to_multiple_of: 8
quant: q4f
use_prefix_cache: true
```

ana: quick thought: cormorant's tokenizer maps NBSP (0xA0) -> <unk> in the HF tokenizer we pulled. That makes the chat template's sentinel insertion logic think there's a boundary and injects <|sentinel|>. We should add a tokenizer pre-normalization step to replace NBSP and ZWJ with normal spaces or explicit markers.

sam: +1. I pushed a tiny patch to the eval harness tokenizer adapter to run nfkc + replace  /‍ -> ' '. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/642 (WIP)

priya: thanks. after applying locally, the tokenization error disappears but CI still fails with 504 in q4f. non-quant runs succeed.

liam: for the quant runner timeout, check the quantized kernel selection path. If the compiled kernel expects int8 KV layout but runtime feeds q4f packed tensors, the kernel may spin waiting for a cond that's never true. logs might show something like `kv_cache_mismatch shape=(... )`

priya: here's the longer log dump: 
```
WARN KernelSelector: selected kernel q4f_packed_v2 for layer 12
ERROR Runner: KVCacheMismatch: expected layout (batch,heads,seq,dim) got (batch,seq,heads,dim)
Traceback (most recent frames omitted)
```

matt: that confirms it. packing permutation is wrong for the q4f path. There was a recent refactor that introduced an axis reorder for ORT/ONNX path but didn't update q4f kernel metadata. I'll open a fix but we should also add a regression test to the CI matrix to catch this.

matt: Proposed CI test: run a tiny chat transcript (N=2, seq=128) through the q4f runner on CI in a non-GPU emulated job (use small model weights or a tiny stub) and assert no 5xx and that KV cache shapes are consistent.

ana: also we need to update metric wiring. cormorant's baseline reference is evaluated with tokenized perplexity and factuality (factscore). The eval harness currently computes perplexity on detokenized outputs which inflates scores when tokenizer mutates NBSP. After pre-normalization we should compute perplexity on normalized-token streams so comparisons are fair.

priya: agreed. I'll add a normalized_token_stream flag to the eval config and patch the perplexity hook.

eva: I updated the dashboard ingestion (metrics-proxy) to accept a new tag model:cormorant-13b and a metric `kv_mismatch_rate` so we can monitor these runner shape regressions across models. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metrics-proxy/pull/198

dev-bot: CI job started: gh-actions/eval-matrix (cormorant-13b) — workflow run 11234

liam: for short-term mitigation, can we add a fallback policy: if quant path fails within 10s, automatically retry on fp16 path and annotate run with `fallback=quant->fp16`? That keeps user-facing SLAs without blocking quant experiments.

sam: done — small change to router policy in my branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runner/pull/879 adds fallback with counters. It increments `fallback_quant_to_fp16` metric.

priya: thanks all. next actions I have: 1) merge tokenizer pre-normalization PR after review 2) add normalized_token_stream flag + update perplexity hook 3) run new CI q4f regression test (matt to add) 4) coordinate with eva to confirm dashboarding works.

matt: I'll open the q4f kernel metadata patch in ~30m and add the CI test.

ana: I'll add a small unit test for chat templates to ensure sentinels are not injected for NBSP/ZWJ cases.

eva: I'll validate the metrics ingestion and add a dashboard tile: kv_mismatch_rate over time + fallback_quant_to_fp16 ratio.

priya: great. If anyone sees intermittent runs that still 504, ping me with the run id. For traceability, save logs under `s3://redwood-eval-logs/cormorant-13b/<run_id>/` and link it. Thanks :thumbsup:

sam: :eyes:
